name: a command in the middle of a line is carried out between its words
because: the writer put the stage direction mid-sentence, so the host hears it there: the words before it open the line, and the words after it go on with the same line rather than opening another -- a port that said the whole line first, or that gave the rest its own speaker, would show the direction late or split one sentence in two

perform.action: Yuki hides a smile behind her sleeve
